=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py (and its root twin .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py):check_pr_hand_back, around the `if not failed:` / `if due is None and not conflicted:` boundary (~line 782-787 in the diff) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `due` is only assigned inside the `if not failed:` block. When a claude/* PR has failed check runs (the ci-failed path), `failed` is non-empty, the `if not failed:` block is skipped, `due` is never defined, and the very next line `if due is None and not conflicted:` raises `UnboundLocalError: local variable 'due' referenced before assignment`.
  WHY: Any claude/* PR with a failed CI check (a common case the hand-back mode explicitly handles as `ci-failed`) crashes the hand-back check instead of returning the `ci-failed` verdict. The existing test `test_failed_check_with_nothing_running_is_due_without_an_age_window` exercises this path — it would now raise. The fix is to initialize `due = None` before the `if not failed:` block.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py (and its root twin .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py):`_review_stall_verdict`, the line `commit = gh_api(f"repos/{repo}/commits/{head_sha}")` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The head-commit read has no error handling. If `gh_api` raises (404 on a force-pushed-away head, 5xx, rate limit, network error), the exception propagates out of `_review_stall_verdict`, out of `check_pr_hand_back`, and crashes the checker process instead of degrading gracefully.
  WHY: A transient API failure or a stale head misclassifies the PR — the checker exits non-zero, the hand-back is never delivered, and the dead-man's switch must wait up to 7 days for recovery instead of the next 60-minute check reporting "open" with a reason. The function's docstring says it returns a dict; callers do not expect an exception from this path. Wrap the commit read in a try/except that returns an "open" verdict with a reason naming the failure (or let a `ReadError` propagate so the caller returns exit 2 `retry`).
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
